Aisha (CS): Morning—dropping this week's onboarding health snapshot for Pelago. Focus: token usage + throughput QoQ/WoW. TL;DR: tokens drifting down WoW, QoQ still up; p95 latency regressed, small error spike, spend slightly above forecast.
Connor (AE): thanks—can you paste the quick numbers?
Aisha (CS): sure — quick paste from our monitor: 
```
WoW tokens: -7% (avg 1.85M/day this week vs 2.0M last)
QoQ tokens: +18% (seasonal cohort ramp)
Throughput p50/p95: 120ms / 430ms (p95 +85ms WoW)
5xx rate: 1.1% (was 0.18% two weeks ago)
Avg weekly spend: $14,200 (+9% vs forecast)
Active seats: 42 (no change)
```
Mei (CSE): ugh that p95 jump — any correlation with long-context calls or new model?
Aisha (CS): flagged: there was a canary of gptx-8k-quant on Tue that overlapped with their peak. Deploy logs show a small KV cache miss pattern. ops-bot: deploy gptx-8k-quant to us-west-2 completed 2029-11-05T14:32:10Z :white_check_mark:
Sam (Solutions): thinking — we saw similar with other accounts when batch sizes increased. Could be autoscaler thrash during their sudden afternoon ramp. Do we have per-route concurrency?
Aisha (CS): yes, and their top route is /chat-stream-main (70% of calls). Per-route concurrency is 24 configured; actual peak concurrency hit 82 during Wed 15:00 UTC.
Connor (AE): renewal touchpoint next Tue — is this a churn risk?
Aisha (CS): currently medium risk. Usage QoQ healthy but recent latency + errors could impact UX. Action: propose short-term mitigations and schedule enablement session.
Mei (CSE): I can run a quick mitigation play: 1) temporary limit per-tenant concurrency to 48, 2) enable prefix KV caching with 30m TTL on chat route, 3) pin to gptx-4k-quant fallback for heavy sessions. Want to run now?
Sam (Solutions): +1 to caching and pinning. For concurrency cap, we should coordinate with infra to avoid dropping requests—maybe gradual throttle.
Aisha (CS): plan: Mei to deploy KV cache & pin; Sam to open infra ticket for gradual concurrency cap; Connor to mention mitigation in renewal note.
Connor (AE): will do. Also, any cost ops recs? They are +9% week vs forecast.
Aisha (CS): short-term: enable intelligent batching for their highest-volume route (expected ~15% token savings), and set soft usage alerts for >10% sustained spend over forecast. Long-term review on next Q planning.
ops-bot: ticket INF-4821 created for concurrency throttling (assigned eng-oncall).
Mei (CSE): deploying cache and pin now — ETA ~18m. 
Aisha (CS): great — I'll follow up with a brief to Connor for renewal and send a 30-min enablement invite for next Wed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (Solutions): note for postmortem: collect traces comparing gptx-8k-quant vs gptx-4k-quant for identical prompts — will help tuning quant profiles.
Aisha (CS): added to action list. I'll update this thread once we see p95 move.
Connor (AE): cheers. If latency drops quickly we'll mention it on the renewal call.
Mei (CSE): cache/pin done — monitoring now. p95 currently 410ms, will report in 30. :eyes:
